newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE TO ENFORCE PARTIAL WEEKEND BAN ON TRUCKS.
newsitem.headline: GREECE TO ENFORCE PARTIAL WEEKEND BAN ON TRUCKS.

text.p: Greece will begin enforcing a partial ban on trucks driving on weekends and public holidays over the summer period, the transport ministry said.
The ban, applying to trucks weighing over 1.5 tonnes, comes into effect on July 18 and ends on September 14.
Trucks will be restricted from travelling on major national roads for up to seven hours on Friday and Sunday evenings, when there is increased traffic on the roads.

The restrictions will also apply on public holidays and on the eve of public holidays. Road assistance lorries and those carrying milk and fresh fish will be exempt from the restrictions. --Maria Petrakis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
